shell.subtitle: Statistical process and manufacturing quality analysis

parts.title: Product part master
parts.subtitle: Manage production parts, specifications and customer information
parts.guideIntro: Use this module to register production parts. In SPC, sampling inspection data must be linked to a specific product part.

characteristics.title: Quality characteristic master
characteristics.subtitle: Define variable and attribute inspection characteristics, measurement units and default SPC charts
characteristics.guideIntro: Build an inspection characteristic dictionary, such as length, weight and copper ion concentration.
characteristics.guideVariable: Characteristics measured as numeric values, such as length of 10.5 mm.
characteristics.guideAttribute: Characteristics expressed as nonconforming counts, proportions or defect counts.

processes.title: Process configuration
processes.subtitle: Manage processes and configure production machines by station
processes.guideFirst: 1. Select a process on the left, or add a process using the button above.
processes.guideSecondAfter: section, add or edit machines for this station.
processes.guideThird: 3. Maintain process, chemical and product control items in SPC control items. This master manages only processes and machines.

traceability.title: Line and tank settings
traceability.subtitle: Configure chemical tanks for each line
traceability.guideIntro: Configure tanks within each line. SPC imports and chemical control items use the line-to-tank mapping to identify production locations.
traceability.guideNext: Create a process in the process master, then select it here to configure tanks.
traceability.sourceHelp: The left side uses the process master directly; do not recreate lines here.
traceability.addHelp: Select a process, then add tanks on the right. Codes are generated automatically.
traceability.orderHelp: Processes follow the process master order; tanks follow their configured display order.

groups.title: Control chart categories
groups.subtitle: Add, edit, delete and enable or disable control chart categories
groups.guideIntro: Configure top-level SPC categories, such as PROC process control, CHEM chemical control and PROD product control, to organize control charts.
groups.scopeHelp: Use the same code for control charts and trend charts belonging to the same business workflow.

rules.title: SPC eight control rules
rules.subtitle: Western Electric rules 1–8 are fixed; parameters and enabled status can be adjusted

segmentDetails.title: Date segments and version details
segmentDetails.intro: The following shows current settings, change history and saved calculation evidence. Viewing does not recalculate data.

segmentDetails.dateEntry: Select a date range to view details.

segmentDetails.baseRange: Master settings (fallback only when no segment matches or a segment field is empty)
segmentDetails.limitsNotice: Specifications and limits show current settings. Change snapshots do not identify the version used for a measurement. Control limits have no independent version history, so the version at the time cannot be confirmed. Unset control limits may be estimated from chart statistics; check the chart.
segmentDetails.noSpec: No specification version records. History is not fabricated.
segmentDetails.formulaNotice: For measurements without saved traceability, the formula version actually used at the time cannot be confirmed. See the saved evidence above for new data. Change dates are not effective dates. The history below includes all changes to this control item and does not identify the formula applicable to this segment.
segmentDetails.noFormula: No formula version records. History is not fabricated.
segmentDetails.fNotice: F table version used: cannot confirm the version at the time (only for old measurements without saved calculation traces; see saved evidence for new data).
segmentDetails.notApplicable: Chemical analysis formulas and F table: not applicable.
segmentDetails.statisticalConfig: Current control line calculation settings (not evidence of the version used at the time)

calculationEvidence.title: Saved formula calculation evidence
calculationEvidence.measurementTitle: Saved formula calculation history for this measurement
calculationEvidence.rangeTitle: Range measurements and formulas actually used
calculationEvidence.notice: Only saved evidence is read; no recalculation occurs. The calculation judgment at the time may differ from the current chart. Check specifications and precision. Specifications are snapshots at calculation time; independent specification version numbers and control limit versions at the time were not recorded.
calculationEvidence.aggregate: This point aggregates multiple measurements without all member identifiers. A single formula version cannot be confirmed for the subgroup. Inspect individual measurements through date segments; the first measurement does not represent the whole subgroup.
calculationEvidence.noId: This point is a derived statistic or has no measurement identifier, so a formula for one measurement cannot be identified. Inspect individual measurements through date segments.
calculationEvidence.notApplicable: Not chemical data; analysis formula traceability is not applicable.
calculationEvidence.rangeCount: All measurements in this PPC date range: {total} (not limited by the chart batch filter); measurements without saved version links: {unknown}.
calculationEvidence.multiple: Multiple formula versions were saved in this range. Check each measurement; do not treat them as a single formula.
calculationEvidence.empty: No measurements in this range. No formula is inferred.
calculationEvidence.unknown: Cannot confirm the version at the time (old measurement without saved traceability).
calculationEvidence.incomplete: Calculation evidence is incomplete and cannot be confirmed. The current formula is not substituted.
calculationEvidence.results: Raw calculation result: {raw}; stored result: {stored}; specification judgment at calculation time: {judgment}
calculationEvidence.specification: Specification snapshot at calculation time: segment {segment}; LSL {lsl} / USL {usl} / target {target}
calculationEvidence.invalidResponse: The calculation evidence response has an invalid format. Please retry later.

chartSummary.title: SPC control item overview
chartSummary.empty: No calculable measurements for these conditions
chartSummary.rankingNotice: Rankings use only the current weekly/monthly query results.
chartSummary.twoSided: Two-sided specifications: Cpk = min((USL − mean) / (3 × σwithin), (mean − LSL) / (3 × σwithin)); Ppk uses σoverall.
chartSummary.upperOnly: USL only: Cpk = (USL − mean) / (3 × σwithin); Ppk = (USL − mean) / (3 × σoverall).
chartSummary.lowerOnly: LSL only: Cpk = (mean − LSL) / (3 × σwithin); Ppk = (mean − LSL) / (3 × σoverall).
chartSummary.sigmaNotice: σwithin is short-term within-subgroup variation; σoverall is overall long-term variation across report measurements.
chartSummary.ppkNotice: The report column is labeled Cpk but displays the backend Ppk value, representing overall capability for the entire period.
